faq.sub: Preguntas técnicas, comerciales y logísticas sobre la placa de cemento fibra Terasun TSM.

ce.question: Does Terasun TSM have CE marking?
ce.answer: Yes. CE 1023-CPR-1565 P. The product complies with the EU Construction Products Regulation and carries CE marking for sale and use across the European Economic Area.

eta.question: Is there a European Technical Assessment (ETA)?
eta.answer: Yes. ETA 24/0895 has been issued by a designated ETA body. It independently confirms the product's performance characteristics for its intended uses. Full ETA available for download.

epd.question: Is there an EPD (Environmental Product Declaration)?
epd.answer: Yes. EPD-IES-0018268, published 2025-03-14, valid until 2029-03-14. ISO 14025 compliant. Declared unit: 1 m² at 12 mm, weight 9.96 kg/m². Supports LEED, BREEAM, and DGNB certification projects.

weight.question: What is the declared weight of the board?
weight.answer: The declared weight per EPD-IES-0018268 is 9.96 kg/m² at 12 mm thickness. Thinner boards are proportionally lighter. Full thickness/weight table in the technical data sheet.

fire.question: What fire resistance does the board achieve?
fire.answer: The tested system achieves E 120 (integrity 120 min), EI 90 (integrity and insulation 90 min), and EW 120 (integrity and radiation limitation 120 min). Test reference: FIRES-CR-284-25-AUPE. These are system-level classifications — specify the tested system configuration.

wetroom.question: Can Terasun TSM be used in wet rooms?
wetroom.answer: Yes. Approved as a tile backing substrate in Mapei and Schönox wet room systems. Dimensionally stable, moisture-resistant substrate for bathrooms, showers, and commercial kitchens.

facade.question: Can the board be used for exterior facade cladding?
facade.answer: Yes. Specified as the facade board in CBSS and CBMV ventilated facade systems. Can also be used as a render carrier. Suitable for all European climate zones.

asbestos.question: Is the board asbestos-free?
asbestos.answer: Yes. Terasun TSM is completely asbestos-free. The board uses Portland cement with inorganic binders and fibreglass mesh reinforcement. REACH SVHC declaration confirming no SVHC above 0.1% w/w is available.

moq.question: What is the minimum order quantity?
moq.answer: Minimum order is typically one 20-foot container (approx. 1,600–2,200 m² depending on thickness). Smaller quantities may be available from Finnish warehouse stock. Contact us for availability.

samples.question: Are samples available before placing an order?
samples.answer: Yes. Physical samples and documentation packs are available to qualified distributors, architects, and contractors. Contact us to request a sample pack including board, TDS, CE certificate, and ETA.

leadtime.question: How long does delivery take?
leadtime.answer: Container orders take approximately 6–10 weeks from order confirmation to European port delivery. DDP warehouse delivery adds 1–2 weeks. Finnish stock: 1–2 weeks.

origin.question: Where is the product manufactured?
origin.answer: Manufactured by Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd. in Zhejiang Province, People's Republic of China. Terasun Europe is the Authorised European Representative responsible for CE documentation and EU market compliance.

whoIsTerasun.question: What is Terasun Europe?
whoIsTerasun.answer: Terasun Europe is the Authorised European Representative for Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd., based in Vantaa, Finland. We manage CE documentation, EU market compliance, and European customer relationships. We are not the manufacturer of Terasun products.

authorisation.question: Is there an authorisation letter from the manufacturer?
authorisation.answer: Yes. Official authorisation letter from Zhejiang Terasun Air Duct Co., Ltd. confirming Terasun Europe as the Authorised European Representative is available for review.

distributor.question: Can I become a distributor in my country?
distributor.answer: Yes. We are actively seeking stocking distributors and project partners across Europe. Territory-based agreements, competitive margins, documentation support, and technical training. Contact us to discuss.

openMarkets.question: Which countries are open for distribution?
openMarkets.answer: Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, France, Spain, Portugal, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, Hungary, and others are open for new distribution partners. Contact us for territory availability.

studSpacing.question: What stud spacing is required?
studSpacing.answer: Compatible with 400 mm and 600 mm stud spacing in both timber and steel frame systems. Specific recommendations depend on board thickness, orientation, and load — refer to the technical data sheet.

training.question: Is technical training available for distributors?
training.answer: Yes. Technical product training, installation guidance, and documentation support are available to registered distributors. Training can be delivered on-site or remotely.

publicProjects.question: Can Terasun TSM be used on public and infrastructure projects?
publicProjects.answer: Yes. CE, ETA, DoP, EPD, and fire test documentation meets the requirements of public sector procurement across Europe. Full documentation packs available for specification and tender submission.

cuttingTools.question: What cutting tools are needed for installation?
cuttingTools.answer: Terasun TSM can be cut with a circular saw or angle grinder fitted with a fibre cement or diamond blade. Score-and-snap for straight cuts on thinner boards. Wear a dust mask and eye protection. Full guidance in the installation manual.

contact.sub: Use this form to request a price, sample, technical documentation, or to apply for distribution. We respond within 1 business day.

installation.h1: Instalación de la placa de fibrocemento Terasun TSM
installation.sub: Guía completa para contratistas — herramientas, corte, fijación, juntas, protección contra la intemperie y acabado.

tools.title: Tools required
tools.body: Circular saw or angle grinder with fibre cement blade, drill/driver, measuring tape, chalk line, and PPE (dust mask, goggles).

cutting.title: Cutting methods
cutting.body: Cut with circular saw (fibre cement blade) or score-and-snap for straight cuts on thinner boards. Wet cutting reduces dust.

fastening.title: Fastening
fastening.body: Fix with stainless steel or corrosion-resistant self-tapping screws or annular ring nails. Min 12 mm edge distance, 200 mm edge spacing, 300 mm field spacing.

joints.title: Joints & gaps
joints.body: Leave 3 mm expansion gap at all board edges. Tape and fill butt joints for interior. For exterior, leave open joints with sealant or cover with feature joint profiles.

weather.title: Weather protection
weather.body: Do not install in freezing conditions. Protect boards from rain until system is weather-sealed. Store under cover — boards must not sit in standing water.

finishing.title: Finishing & paint
finishing.body: Prime with alkali-resistant primer before paint or render. Compatible with mineral, silicone, and acrylic finishes. Interior surfaces can be directly tiled with polymer-modified adhesive.

installation.downloadText: Orientación completa de instalación incluyendo planos del sistema, patrones de fijación y requisitos del sustrato.
